svg.aria-label: Energy bookkeeping for three scattering processes. The index v labels the lower (0) and higher (1) vibrational states shown. Equal upward arrows indicate equal incident photon energy. Stokes scattering leaves vibrational energy in the molecule; anti-Stokes scattering removes existing vibrational energy. The dashed virtual level represents the scattering process, not a stable excited electronic state.
